weapon.d: During unit's first combat in player phase or enemy phase, grants Atk/Res+5 to unit and restores 7 HP to unit after combat.
During unit's first combat in player phase or enemy phase, grants Atk/Res+5 to unit and restores 7 HP to unit after combat.

For foes within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit, deals 10 damage to foe as their combat begins (effects that reduce damage during combat do not apply; will not reduce foe's HP below 1) and inflicts Atk/Res-5 on foe during their combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 7 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Res.
Boosts damage by 80% of unit's Res.

a.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Res+3, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Res+4, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Res+5, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.

c.d: At start of turn, inflicts Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Def/Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces of unit through their next actions.
At start of turn, inflicts Def/Res-4 on foes within 2 spaces of unit through their next actions.
